name: sportsdata-mcp
description: Live sports data and cross-book betting odds from 63 providers.
long_description:
801 tools across 63 providers: AFL, NRL, NBA, MLB, NHL, EPL, LaLiga, Serie A, F1, tennis, cricket, golf, chess and esports, alongside live prices from Sportsbet, TAB, PointsBet, BetR, Unibet, Entain, Dabble, Betfair and Pinnacle.

43 of those providers need no key, no signup and no configuration — install it and everything works. The remaining providers are optional and unlock by pasting a key you get yourself; leave them blank and they simply stay hidden.

groups.title: Tool groups
groups.description: Which tools to expose. 'free' (the default) is every provider that needs no key. Other presets: all, racing, arb, fantasy, au-books, official-stats, motorsport, esports. Provider globs (espn.*) and exclusions (all,-twitter) also work.

api_sports_key.title: API-Sports key
api_sports_key.description: Optional — ten sports on one key, including rugby union.

sportsgameodds_api_key.title: SportsGameOdds key
sportsgameodds_api_key.description: Optional — player props with stable market ids.

cfbd_api_key.title: College Football Data key
cfbd_api_key.description: Optional — SP+, Elo and college-football analytics.

api_tennis_key.title: API-Tennis key
api_tennis_key.description: Optional — ATP and ITF draws, H2H and rankings.

pandascore_token.title: PandaScore token
pandascore_token.description: Optional — CS2, LoL, Valorant and R6 esports.

datagolf_key.title: Data Golf key
datagolf_key.description: Optional — fields, live models and betting markets.
